subject: Urgent: Applications not appearing from shared interview link
latest_message:
Hi Filip,

*Thank you for following up and for sharing that feedback with us.*

Regarding the two links you mentioned, I would like to clarify their
different functions to help you choose the best one for your workflow:

1. The job post link is intended for the initial application stage. To
ensure candidates can begin the interview immediately after applying,
please verify in your job post configuration that the screening AI
interview is enabled.

[image: image.png]
Otherwise, you need to manually invite them after they submit their CV.
[image: image.png]

2. The direct AI interview link (the one including the project ID)* is
specifically designed for candidates you have already shortlisted and wish
to invite directly to the interview stage.* You may send this link for
every candidate as well (if you don't want to screen their CV first)

3. Regarding the permissions issue you encountered with your team
member, *could
you please provide that individual's email add
